subject: general
question: In which of the following states is the Panna National Park located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Panna National Park was established in 1981.
 
• It is located in the Panna and Chhatarpur districts of Madhya Pradesh in India.
 
• It was declared in 1994 as the twenty-second Tiger reserve of India and the fifth in Madhya Pradesh, 
 
• It was given the Award of Excellence in 2007 as the best-maintained national park of India by the Ministry of Tourism of India.
 
• Ken river drains through the National Park.
 
• It houses a reptile park.
 
• Panna was recognized as the 18th biosphere reserve in the year 2011 by the government of India.
 
• Panna was granted biosphere reserve status by UNESCO in November 2020 under the MAB program.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **
